description: Permanently destroys a server and ALL its data. Needs the canDelete permission. Two steps: call without confirmationToken to get the warning and a token, ask the user, then call again with the token. (permission: servers:delete) [Requires a free GPU Cloud account and MCP key]

confirmationToken.description: Token returned by the previous (quote) call, valid 10 minutes, single use.

name: gpucloud_delete_server
title: Delete a server (irreversible)
